zh.principle: **协议**：TLS 1.1（TLS 1.1）。摘要只声明版本与用途：「This document specifies Version 1.1 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol.The TLS protocol provides communications security over the Internet.」注意用词已是 communications security 而非 1.0 的 privacy；分层不变，但块加密记录的 IV 处理按本版改动（见 §6.2.3.2）。
zh.why: 改动清单在 §1.1，头两条就是本版的目的：「The implicit Initialization Vector (IV) is replaced with an explicit IV to protect against CBC attacks [CBCATT].」与「Handling of padding errors is changed to use the bad_record_mac alert rather than the decryption_failed alert to protect against CBC attacks.」前言自陈这只是「some small security improvements, clarifications, and editorial improvements」。
zh.used: 记录层写下两条义务：接收方「MUST check this padding and SHOULD use the bad_record_mac alert to indicate padding errors.」；面对 Canvel 等人的计时攻击，「implementations MUST ensure that record processing time is essentially the same whether or not the padding is correct.」§9 的强制套件此时已是 TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA，附录 F.3 则说明本版「uses an explicit IV in order to protect against this attack.」
zh.broken: 降级与静态密钥只剩部分处置：§7.4.7.1 写明版本回退检查是不对称的——「Client implementations, MUST and Server implementations MAY, check the version number.」，并把风险轻描淡写为「since the TLS handshake MACs prevent downgrade and no good attacks are known on those MACs, ambiguity is not considered a serious security risk」；填充错误的告警仍只是 SHOULD。压缩顺序也与 1.0 相同，未作禁止。
zh.history:
RFC 4346 头部为 T.Dierks 与 E.Rescorla（RTFM, Inc.），类别 Standards Track，2006 年 4 月，标注「Obsoletes: 2246」，没有 Updates 行；§1.1 自陈是 TLS 1.0 的修订版。

en.principle: **Protocol**: TLS 1.1 (TLS 1.1). The abstract states version and purpose: "This document specifies Version 1.1 of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol. The TLS protocol provides communications security over the Internet." The wording is now security rather than the 1.0 privacy phrasing; the two-layer structure stays, while the IV handling inside block-ciphered records changes as described in §6.2.3.2.
en.why: The change list sits in §1.1 and its first two items are the point of the release: "The implicit Initialization Vector (IV) is replaced with an explicit IV to protect against CBC attacks [CBCATT]." and "Handling of padding errors is changed to use the bad_record_mac alert rather than the decryption_failed alert to protect against CBC attacks." The introduction describes itself as carrying "some small security improvements, clarifications, and editorial improvements".
en.used:
The record layer states two duties: the receiver "MUST check this padding and SHOULD use the bad_record_mac alert to indicate padding errors.", and against the Canvel timing work "implementations MUST ensure that record processing time is essentially the same whether or not the padding is correct." The §9 mandatory suite is now TLS_RSA_WITH_3DES_EDE_CBC_SHA, and Appendix F.3 says this version "uses an explicit IV in order to protect against this attack."

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Downgrade and static-key exposure are only partly handled here: §7.4.7.1 makes the version check asymmetric — "Client implementations, MUST and Server implementations MAY, check the version number." — and plays down the risk, "since the TLS handshake MACs prevent downgrade and no good attacks are known on those MACs, ambiguity is not considered a serious security risk". The padding-error alert is still only a SHOULD, and the record order still compresses before encryption without forbidding compression.
en.history: The RFC 4346 header lists T. Dierks and E. Rescorla (RTFM, Inc.), Category: Standards Track, April 2006, marked "Obsoletes: 2246" with no Updates line; §1.1 presents the document as a revision of TLS 1.0.

zh: 显式 IV：每记录自带 IV，取代 CBC 残值。
bad_record_mac：填充错误改用的单一告警。
[CBCATT]：本版本针对的 CBC 攻击类别。
等时处理：填充对错须花相同时间。
回退版本检查：客户端 MUST、服务器 MAY。
en: Explicit IV: each record carries its own IV instead of the CBC residue.
bad_record_mac: the single alert now used for padding errors.
[CBCATT]: the class of CBC attacks this version targets.
Constant-time handling: padding validity must not change timing.
Rollback check asymmetric: MUST for clients, MAY for servers.
Obsoletes: 2246: the record that supersedes TLS 1.0.
